title: Low-viscosity polyurethane prepolymers based on 2,4'-MDI
authors: Matthias Wintermantel; Walter Meckel; Mathias Matner; Harald Kraus; Frank Kobelka
assignee_or_institution: Bayer MaterialScience AG; current assignee Covestro Deutschland AG
notes: US application published 2006-01-26. Batch 014 structures explicit MDI-isomer/polyether prepolymer examples, DIN EN 1242 NCO assays, 23 C rotational viscosity, GPC residual monomer, two-stage reaction data, and cured sealant mechanical properties. Patent/application status is not used as a quality proxy; example-level traceability is the basis for inclusion.
